title: ExclusionExplanation
description: Explains why a relation, evidence basis, path, community revision, or causal gate was excluded from a time-indexed projection. Provides the machine-readable audit answer to 'why is this not here at time t?', naming the inadmissible evidence units and/or source states responsible.

subjectType.description: The kind of subject that was excluded.

profileId.description: The grounding profile under which exclusion was determined.

queryTime.description: The query time the exclusion applies to.

inadmissibleEvidenceUnitIds.description: Evidence units that were inadmissible at the query time and caused the exclusion.

inadmissibleSourceStateIds.description: Source states that were inadmissible at the query time.

affectedRelationIds.description: Relations affected by the exclusion (e.g. path steps).
